title: South Africa + Zimbabwe
name: South Africa
stays: Cape Town · Kruger · Johannesburg · Victoria Falls
p1: Experience the best of Southern Africa on a perfectly balanced journey of iconic landscapes, rich culture, thrilling adventure and luxury wildlife safaris. From Cape Town’s dramatic coastlines and Table Mountain to Kruger’s wildlife and Johannesburg’s powerful history, with an optional Victoria Falls extension.
p2: Accommodations, guided experiences, transportation, select meals and internal flights are included. This is not a rushed tour; it is a once-in-a-lifetime African experience.
presImg: A lion passing a safari vehicle at dusk
presText: After a flight to the Kruger region and a day of gorge lifts and cliff walks in Graskop, you check into a luxury safari lodge for sunset, morning and afternoon game drives.
staysLine: Cape Town hotel + luxury safari lodge
highlights: Unique adventure experiences: vintage sidecar rides, the world’s longest zipline, kayaking with penguins, the Graskop Gorge Big Swing and cliff walks
Iconic bucket-list visits to Cape Town’s waterfront, Table Mountain’s panoramic city and ocean views, and a scenic Peninsula journey
Exclusive wildlife encounters and a luxury safari experience inside Kruger National Park
Deep cultural immersion visiting townships and authentic dining adventures
Seamless internal flights and private transfers
Perfect pacing, balancing adventure, culture, leisure and wildlife
Optional Victoria Falls extension with a Zambezi sunset cruise, a guided Falls tour and a farewell cultural dinner
